name: The Sarsabz farmer
subtitle: Male, 25-55  ·  Punjab and Sindh  ·  12-150+ acres  ·  50%+ of income from farming  (brief p23)
household: Head of a farming household. Brief p23: male, 25-55, Punjab and Sindh, 12-150+ acres, half or more of income from farming.
Brief p6 describes a wider buyer: 18-60, SEC A to upper D, minimum secondary education. The two definitions differ - settle it with the client.
Farming is a family identity: commenters introduce themselves through a father or grandfather who farmed.
mindset: Judges at product level, on what he has seen work on land like his.
Asks strangers in comment threads what the maker should tell him.
Fears waste more than failure: what will lock up if he mixes.

pain_points.title: Will it lock up if I mix it
pain_points.detail: Whether NP with zinc urea, sulphur or potash reacts and wastes the bag.
pain_points.evidence: 220 of 1,433 agronomy comments (15.4%), the largest theme; 83 about NP or CAN (case2_audit/comments/analysis.md §3, theme_counts.csv)

pain_points.title: Give me the dose for my soil, not the country
pain_points.detail: Wants a per-acre, per-irrigation plan for his soil and district.

pain_points.title: Every expert says something different
pain_points.detail: Creators contradict each other and Fatima's own field practice.
pain_points.evidence: analysis.md §5, verbatim 'Medicine mafia se paise lekar video banner rehta'; 13 trust/advice comments

pain_points.title: Nobody answers me
pain_points.detail: He asks under videos and asks for a WhatsApp number.

pain_points.title: The bag is expensive, and sometimes not there
pain_points.detail: Price and supply surface even under a tribute film.
pain_points.evidence: 35 price plus 10 availability comments (case 2); 19 of 1,516 Salam Kissan comments complain about supply, price and respect (case1_salam_kissan/comments/comment_findings.md)

pain_points.title: Show me proof, in words I use
pain_points.detail: Asks for written evidence; says the advice he gets is too English.
pain_points.evidence: analysis.md §4-5: a request for written proof (translated from Urdu), and verbatim 'Sir English mn to samjh hi nh ati'

triggers.title: The irrigation calendar
triggers.detail: Buys against sowing and first irrigation: Rabi Oct-Mar, Kharif Apr-Sep.

triggers.title: A result on a field like his
triggers.detail: Yield in maunds, from a named farmer in a district he knows.
triggers.evidence: 47 yield-result comments; Ki Jeet films are the brand's most-watched product content (case2_audit/the_audit.md)

triggers.title: A recipe he can copy
triggers.detail: What replaced DAP, mixed with what, on which irrigation, on what soil.

triggers.title: Being addressed, not thanked
triggers.detail: Response is strongest where farmers and families are the voice.
triggers.evidence: comment_findings.md pride-in-family comments; a farmer speaks in 9 of 76 Salam Kissan uploads

interests.title: Interests and affinity index
interests.source: GA4: brandsynario.com visitors in Punjab, male 25-44, 390 of 1,472 users. A website audience, not a farmer sample - directional only.

media.title: Where to reach him (evidenced, no survey)

conclusion: He is not waiting to be persuaded that the product works. He is waiting to be shown how to use it without losing a season - and to be heard, not thanked.
sources: GA4 interests export, brandsynario.com Punjab visitors (data/reference/Punjab.csv)
No media survey supplied, so no percentages are shown; ask Fatima for TGI or Gallup
The name and composite framing are a device; no individual farmer is described
